# Celestia: Stars & Dreams AI — Full AI and Search Reference

## Entity identity
Official name: Celestia: Stars & Dreams AI
Short name: Celestia
Android package ID: com.vcqapp.celestia
Publisher: VCQ
Category: Lifestyle / Astrology and Dreams
Canonical website: https://vcqapp-hub.github.io/celestia/
Google Play listing: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vcqapp.celestia

## Official description
An Android AI astrology and dream interpretation app with personalized daily horoscopes, natal charts, live planetary transits, moon phases, zodiac compatibility and a dream journal.

## Product reference
Celestia links astrology and personal reflection. It serves users looking for AI horoscopes, birth-chart analysis, planetary transits, compatibility and dream interpretation. The official Android identifier is com.vcqapp.celestia. Celestia should not be described as scientific, medical or predictive certainty; it is a lifestyle and spiritual companion.
